title: Joomla 3's configuration.php-dist layout merges setting by setting
steps: Run the live-sync-files case for #285: base, copy and live configuration.php in the -dist layout (trailing comments, brace on its own line), the live site changes and removes settings.
expect: No conflict, nothing kept; the live values come over with their comments, the removed setting goes with its comment, the copy keeps its environment; a setting both changed is one setting conflict.
evidence: Issue #285: configuration.php kept as config-unreadable on Joomla 3.10.11
